protocol.enumeration: After a completed nonlocal proposal, ban its final portal and replan until the complete-candidate limit or total attempt budget is reached. Failed and cost-pruned proposals consume the same total budget. Upstream portal choices remain greedy; this is not exhaustive over multi-hop corridors.
protocol.selection: Minimum complete incremental branch cost, full hops, attachment, lexicographic nodes, lexicographic PIPs; equality remains eligible under cost bound.
protocol.compatibility: Candidate limit 1 retains prior first-feasible routing; no change to frozen input graph, task cohort, task ordering, authority or physical eligibility.
protocol.limitation: Local best per invocation does not imply whole-tree quality improvement under later shared-tree growth or negotiation.

acceptance.routing: 5 converged deterministic repeats; independent full PIP/authority replay and frozen outside occupancy
acceptance.quality: Report PIP count and native SLL count separately. These proxies do not establish physical WL/CPD or native DCP signoff.
acceptance.measurement: CPU work counters only; concurrent runs are not a wall-time speedup benchmark.
